raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 was re-delivered at 05:00 on 2026-01-17, so raw_transactions holds exact duplicate copies of about 317 POSTED txn_ids. The sample rows are identical apart from ingest_ts, and the overall duplicate count (334 extra rows, roughly 5% of them REVERSED) matches the POSTED/REVERSED mix. Deduplicating on txn_id before the status filter, keeping the latest ingest, removes the duplicates and the 2026-01-16 volume spike, and the gold tables inherit the fix.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
